```python
import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB
import json

# Periodendaten
period_data = {
    "1": {"demand": 35, "setup_cost": 468, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    "2": {"demand": 50, "setup_cost": 382, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    "3": {"demand": 43, "setup_cost": 405, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "4": {"demand": 28, "setup_cost": 373, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "5": {"demand": 48, "setup_cost": 304, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "6": {"demand": 20, "setup_cost": 450, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    "7": {"demand": 35, "setup_cost": 230, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    "8": {"demand": 45, "setup_cost": 405, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "9": {"demand": 12, "setup_cost": 121, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2},
    "10": {"demand": 27, "setup_cost": 284, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "11": {"demand": 11, "setup_cost": 304, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "12": {"demand": 21, "setup_cost": 482, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "13": {"demand": 15, "setup_cost": 482, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    "14": {"demand": 12, "setup_cost": 479, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    "15": {"demand": 21, "setup_cost": 259, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5}
}

# Kapazität pro Periode
capacity = {
    "1": 40, "2": 62, "3": 58, "4": 40, "5": 65, "6": 23, "7": 25, "8": 34,
    "9": 10, "10": 38, "11": 16, "12": 25, "13": 18, "14": 13, "15": 18
}

# Modell erstellen
model = gp.Model("Single-Item Lot-Sizing")
model.Params.OutputFlag = 0

# Variablen
production = model.addVars(period_data.keys(), vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name="production")
setup = model.addVars(period_data.keys(), vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="setup")
inventory = model.addVars(period_data.keys(), vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name="inventory")

# Zielfunktion: Gesamtkosten minimieren
model.setObjective(
    gp.quicksum(
        period_data[t]["setup_cost"] * setup[t] +
        period_data[t]["prod_cost"] * production[t] +
        period_data[t]["holding_cost"] * inventory[t]
        for t in period_data.keys()
    ),
    GRB.MINIMIZE
)

# Nebenbedingungen
for t in period_data.keys():
    t_int = int(t)
    # Nachfrage decken
    if t_int == 1:
        model.addConstr(production[t] == period_data[t]["demand"] + inventory[t])
    else:
        model.addConstr(production[t] + inventory[str(t_int - 1)] == period_data[t]["demand"] + inventory[t])
    
    # Kapazitätsbeschränkung
    model.addConstr(production[t] <= capacity[t] * setup[t])

    # Nicht-Negativität der Lagerbestände
    model.addConstr(inventory[t] >= 0)

# Optimierung
model.optimize()

# Ergebnisse
production_plan = {t: int(production[t].X) for t in period_data.keys()}
objective_value = model.ObjVal

# Ausgabe
result = {
    "production": production_plan,
    "objective_value": objective_value
}

print(json.dumps(result))
```
